values.note: Storm closure of Hatteras Island to visitors. KOA's banner: '10/16/26 Dare County has issued an emergency evacuation order for all visitors on Hatteras Island. Please call us if you need to make changes to your reservation.' Dare County, 2026-10-22: 'N.C. Highway 12 is closed between the Marc Basnight Bridge and Rodanthe. A mandatory evacuation for visitors remains in effect, and visitor entry is prohibited.' No reopening date posted.

status.source: https://koa.com/campgrounds/cape-hatteras/ (alert banner dated 10/16/26) + https://www.darenc.gov/ (Hatteras Island status line and Bulletins #1-#7), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Strongly seasonal. KOA's booking form, one night, RV, 2 adults, a 23-ft motorhome, site rate before tax: Tue 2027-01-12 and 2027-03-09 $35 (Back In 30/20-amp water/electric, near bathhouse) to $95 (dune full-hookup with shade shelter); Tue 2027-05-18 $70 to $130 (5 of 11 types available); Tue 2027-07-13 $150 (back-in water/electric) to $260 (KOA Patio full hookup). Monthly RV stays from $895/month by phone.

values.note: KOA lists a 90-ft max length. 11 RV site types, back-in and pull-through, water/electric or full hookups; some with shade shelters, KOA Patios, a Paw Pen, on the dune or a short walk to the beach.

sites.source: https://koa.com/campgrounds/cape-hatteras/ ('90' Max Length') + reserve page site types, read 2026-10-22

values.note: Pool open year-round, hot tub, snack bar (Tiki Hut), propane, firewood, pavilion, dog park, direct beach access.

values.note: KOA's booking form, 2027: 'Stay requires a 2 Night Minimum if arriving on Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday or Sunday for stays between 04/01/2027 and 10/31/2027.' No minimum shown for January or March nights. Monthly stays by phone.

note: KOA Resort at 25099 NC Hwy 12, Rodanthe, between the Atlantic and Pamlico Sound with direct beach access; some RV sites sit on the dune or a short walk from the beach. Hatteras Island is reached only by NC 12 across Pea Island, which ocean overwash closes in storms: closed with visitors evacuated in September and again from October 16, 2026 (Dare County). --Claude
summary: KOA page and booking form: added a temporary storm closure (Dare County visitor evacuation of Hatteras Island since 2026-10-16, NC 12 closed, no reopening date); fees $70-130 -> $35-260 (Jan/Mar $35 to July $260 for 2027); 50-amp full hookups; 90-ft max with pull-throughs; Wi-Fi; a 2-night minimum every day April 1 - October 31; military 5% for KOA Rewards members. Note trimmed of the price and rating lines. Not stated: site count, season (Jan/Mar nights are sold), showers/laundry/dump.
flags: Temporary storm closure recorded: KOA's banner quotes Dare County's 10/16/26 emergency evacuation order for all Hatteras Island visitors, and darenc.gov on 2026-10-22 says NC 12 is closed between the Marc Basnight Bridge and Rodanthe and 'visitor entry is prohibited'. Likely to lift within weeks; needs a re-check soon.
Standing minimum: KOA's booking form requires 2 nights for any arrival day April 1 - October 31, 2027 (seven months). Recorded in booking.min_stay; a 2-night standing minimum stays if marked.

Price gate: base $35 (Jan/Mar 2027) but $70 in May and $150 in July 2027 for the cheapest RV site, over US$50 in season; within 36 km of the Cape Hatteras gateway (gateways.py), so the gate is lifted. Family has not stayed here.
